items.title: Pennsylvania will require labels on AI-generated ads
items.excerpt: Pennsylvania’s AI Deceptive Advertising Act leaves a lot of loopholes.

items.title: Now Google says it might use your Gmail and Google Photos data to target ads
items.excerpt: According to the new terms, sharing your data for better AI recommendations also means opening it up for more personalized ads.

items.title: OpenAI Foists Creative ‘Enhancements’ On Advertisers; Now The News Is Partnering With Sportsbooks
items.excerpt: OpenAI will automatically update existing ads with what it calls “creative enhancements” starting Oct. 30 – unless advertisers opt out.

items.title: Q3: Omnicom’s Media Business Is Growing, But Is It Agent-Proof?
items.excerpt: If AI agents can plan and buy media, who needs a holding company? Good question. It came up during Omnicom's Q3 earnings on Thursday.

items.title: Meta Grows Revenue 26% Despite Massive Muse Operating Costs
items.excerpt: Despite spending billions in lawsuits and high Muse operating costs, Meta's third quarter earnings still showed significant growth.

items.title: AI boosts discovery but reviews still seal the deal, new research shows
items.excerpt: ChatGPT is where 16% of shoppers start looking for products. However, only 9% go there to actually buy something.

items.title: Target’s holiday push stresses affordability, exclusives and an AI assistant
items.excerpt: Target is betting on daily deals and a digital assistant to woo budget-conscious shoppers this holiday season.

items.title: Etsy updates AI use policies to emphasize craftsmanship
items.excerpt: While it’s implementing more AI, the online marketplace now requires at least one authentic, non-AI generated image in most seller listings.

items.title: Google Ads Translation Tool
items.excerpt: Google Ads is now rolling out the Translation tool within the advertiser console. This allows advertisers to "Translate your campaigns to reach global customers and boost your conversions," Google wrote.

items.title: Google Universal Cart In Search Is Live
items.excerpt: Last week, we reported that Google was launching its Universal Cart in the United States after demoing it at Google I/O in May.  And yes, a few days after Google announced it, it was rolling out. I think most people started to see it show up in Google Search and Gemini starting on Friday and over the weekend.

items.title: Google Ads Updates To Customer Lifecycle Goals For Holidays
items.excerpt: Google Ads is rolling out three updates to customer lifecycle goals to help advertisers before the holidays. These three updates include (1) expanding high value mode to Shopping Campaigns, (2) expanding customer retention goals and (3) new percentage multipliers.

items.title: IAB Europe finds 86% use AI for marketing, but only 48% have ad rules
items.excerpt: Of 50 European ad businesses surveyed, 78% name an AI governance owner and 58% expect agentic buying within a year. How far does practice really lag ambition?

items.title: IAB Tech Lab extends AI ad-buying standard comments to November 10
items.excerpt: Window on the 71-field draft now runs 49 days, not 30, for buyers, sellers and agent builders. Machine-readable schemas still wait on what comments change.

items.title: Google and Meta's new terms carry EU fine risk of up to 10% of sales
items.excerpt: Meta's free cash flow was -$2.12bn in Q3 and Alphabet's -$5.9bn in Q2, yet both hold over $80bn in cash. Which EU rules do the new terms test, and how hard?

items.title: Advertisers Pull Meta Ads That Had Unwanted AI Glow-ups
items.excerpt: Under Meta’s new terms coming into play Oct 30, advertisers are “solely responsible” for whatever its AI creates

items.title: Tilly Norwood Tells All
items.excerpt: In an on-stage conversation at the Industry Leadership Summit in Orlando, AI-generated actress, model, and singer Tilly Norwood discusses the future of marketing.
